detail.diagnosis: The fixed Add to Cart button is obscured by the sticky promo bar, making it unclickable

openWeight.rationale: Repair correctly addresses diagnosed overlap: #add-to-cart (fixed bottom:16px, h52, z10) was obscured by sticky-promo (fixed bottom:0, h84, z20) per hitIsSelf:false at all viewports and screenshot. Moving to bottom:100px = 84px promo +16px gap makes button hit-testable with no overlap, preserving both elements. EvidenceAfter shows 3 interactive-usable failures and pointer-purchase-works fixed, no new regressions; remaining cart-total failures are pre-existing and unrelated to this UI fix.

detail.diagnosis: Cart total uses a stale legacy unit price instead of the catalog price for nova-sneaker

openWeight.rationale: Fix correctly replaces stale LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) with product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG, aligning cart total with displayed $89.00 (8900) for nova-sneaker. Minimal change avoids hardcoding, uses single source of truth, and is verified by deterministicProbePassAfter true and no remaining failing signals.
